title: Pulsar APX Pro Mouthpiece
description:
This mouthpiece includes the silicone cushion insert and metal screens that create a tight seal on the heating chamber and helps every hit to be smooth and clean. Certified replacement part for the Pulsar APX Pro Dry Herb Vape.

Details:
Plastic mouthpiece tip
Replacement part for the Pulsar APX Pro Dry Herb Vape
Includes metal screen
Sold individually

Looking for Screens?
Recommend Vapir Prima Cap Screens

Disclaimer: Not reverse compatible with the APX V2 or V3 Dry Herb Vaporizer
